reproduction.beforeFix: The source-isolation check approved aliases used by JSX images, SVG, cross-file imports, browser media elements, and form submission targets.
reproduction.afterFix: The source-isolation check rejects statically resolved HTTP(S) requests at each covered browser resource sink.

rootCause: Regex-only detection matched direct URL literals but did not resolve static values and imports used by JSX or browser API request sinks.
remediation: Use the existing TypeScript compiler API to parse scanned JS/TS sources and resolve statically known const strings, aliases, concatenation, template literals, URL objects, and local imports at resource-loading JSX attributes, media elements, and form request targets. No submitted code is executed.

runtimeBoundary: Static source analysis is not a sandbox proof. Isolated preview origin and host CSP remain the runtime controls; deployed verification remains pending.
